answer: Register one mirror-silvering atelier per applicant, with a 150 token deposit frozen 120 days and a 95 dollar license. The applicant silvers a mirror by hand while a warden photographs it beside the ivory-handled burnisher and signs the log with a plume quill. Twice a season the warden holds the mirror to lamplight and checks the stamp against the registry. A bought mirror fails. Forging 10,000 ateliers freezes 1,500,000 tokens and costs 950,000 dollars. A hall of mirrors fools the eye. Lift one pane out and weigh it. The copy is light, the deposit burns, and the forger waits 180 days.
